text: You warned them. You didn't have to.
If anyone can change that place, it's you. I'm with you all the way.
Same. Let's make the world a better place.
They're free. Every one of them.
About time.
Freedom, bought like that?
I wanted them free. Not like this.
A dictator, huh? Gosh, it's as if we've learned nothing from a rather large war two hundred years ago.
You took everything he was. Just like that.
Huh.
Let the whole Commonwealth hear it.
Families can trust each other again. You did good, hon.
Say it again. I want to hear it again.
Solid. That should keep things running smooth.
That's exactly what they made me for. Pretending to be someone.
Why? We went through this ourselves.
Would you do that to me? If it made things easier?
Danse... I'm sorry.
No more coursers. No more cages.
Hell yeah. For the people, of the people.
They're free. Every synth down there. So... am I?
Hell yeah you are.
Then I choose this. I choose you two.
Then I'm staying. Because I want to, not because I'm told.
...Okay. I'll take that.
Right. Of course.
She's earned it.
